description: This Java class 'MessageOnlyLogFilter' implements the 'LogNode' interface and acts as a filter in a logging chain, forwarding only the log message without metadata or tags. It is used to simplify log output for readability.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A log filter that outputs only the message part of logs, useful for simplified logging display.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
methods.description: Constructor that takes the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Filters the log message, passing only the message part to the next node.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode to send log data to.
